key.name: directories
key.description: Absolute paths of the folders shown as tabs, in tab order.

key.name: send-sounds-to-call
key.description: Whether sounds are played into the virtual microphone in addition to the local output.

key.name: monitor-volume
key.description: Position of the slider that sets how loud sounds are on the local output, from 0 to 1.

key.name: call-volume
key.description: Position of the slider that sets how loud sounds are in the virtual microphone, from 0 to 1.

key.name: microphone
key.description: PipeWire node name of the microphone mixed into the virtual one. Empty follows the system default.

key.name: monitor-output
key.description: PipeWire node name of the output where sounds are heard. Empty follows the system default.

key.name: include-my-voice
key.description: Whether the microphone is passed through the virtual microphone.
